definitions.short: an assembly , especially on a festival or holiday
definitions.full: H6116. atsarah or atsereth עֲצֶ֫רֶת עֲצָרָה, noun feminine assembly ( ? as confined, held in ); — absolute עֲצָרָה Isa 1:13 2 t.; עֲצֶ֫רֶת Deut 16:8 3 t., עֲצָ֑רֶת 2Chr 7:9 ; construct עֲצֶ֑רֶת Jer 9:1 ; plural suffix עַצְרֹתֵיכֶם Amos 5:21 ; — 1 sacred assembly , rejected by ׳י , Isa 1:13 and (at Bethel, etc.) Amos 5:21 ; for Baal 2Kin 10:20 ; Deut 16:8 (last day of Maƒƒoth ), Lev 23:36 (P), Num 29:35 (P), Neh 8:18 (all of day after feast of booths), compare 2Chr 7:9 [Late Hebrew of feast of weeks, עֲצַרְתָּא ᵑ7 Jos Ant. iii. 10 , 6 Ἀσάρτα ]; occasional, Joel 1:14 ; 2:15 . 2 assemblage, company (in General), ׳ע בֹּגְדִים Jer 9:1 an assemblage of deceivers (Gr עֲדַת ; Che חֶבְרַת ).

occurrences.englishText: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
“ ‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;
Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work.
Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!”
On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.
Oh that my head were waters,
I hate, I despise your feasts,
